name: Restoran 010 — Siparişler geçmişi açılır
description: Demo Restoran (010) Restoran kabuğunda Siparişler karosu adisyon/sipariş geçmişini açar.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the RetailEX login page
Connect tenant retailex_demo if needed, then sign in as admin / admin
Select firm Demo Restoran (010), pick a store if needed, and enter the app
Open the top shell module labeled Restoran
If Günü başlat is visible, click it to start the day
Click the dashboard tile labeled Siparişler
Verify an order history / adisyon list screen is visible with a list, filters, or empty-state for past orders
